description: Noto is an AI-enabled platform transforming specialty therapy to end the mental health crisis. The Noto platform powers working with payers, driving enrollment, and treating Members, enabling multiple specialty therapy brands to scale and fulfill their missions in a sustainable way. Think of it like the engine to each of our specialty therapy brands. Specialties like NOCD and Rebound utilize Noto’s capabilities to identify and surface the root causes of people’s mental health challenges. Once identified, Noto facilitates seamless enrollment into virtual specialty therapy, and delivers evidence-based treatment until Members conquer their symptoms. NOCD was Noto’s first brand and remains the leading provider of therapy for OCD and related disorders. The capabilities developed to scale NOCD now power the Noto platform, allowing specialties like Rebound to benefit. Rebound is the newest specialty on the Noto platform—an evidence- based, specialty therapy service for PTSD and CPTSD.
